description: Letter apparently from Avraham b. Saʿda, who complains about his brother Ṣibyān. Mentions Shemarya b. Elḥanan. Dating: around 1000. The addressee is unknown. It seems that this letter is on the same matter as T-S Misc.35.18 (PGPID 6066), which is the basis for Gil's identification of the sender. (Information from Gil, Kingdom, Vol. 2, #230) VMR
description_he: מכתב המזכיר אדם בשם סבין ואת שמריה בן אל-חנן.
